generationLine: One finished full-color portrait comic page for Echoes of a Forgotten War. One assembled RexPrompt recipe equals one page only. Render only the selected recipe; do not repeat or carry story action, layout, or lettering from another recipe. Do not create a contact sheet, montage, issue summary, cover, multi-page spread, page header, title strip, page number, recipe ID, scene ID, credits, production label, or other annotation unless the assembled recipe explicitly supplies that text as story lettering. Prestige cosmic science-fiction graphic-novel sequential art grounded in human-scale acting and clear physical storytelling. Follow the PANEL PLAN as page architecture, preserve exact recurring character identity and continuity, and letter only the exact DIALOGUE supplied by the recipe. Maintain strong subject/background value separation, intentional series color, readable panel order, and a decisive final-panel beat. Readability first, scale second, spectacle third. No invented dialogue or captions, no character age/design drift, no generic beige or muddy low-contrast grading, no uncontrolled glow/debris, no generic cyberpunk or medieval-fantasy substitution. Fictional production.
